meta.source: FILL: list every source (reference posts, identity page, mockup, theme file). Template values are neutral placeholders.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: FILL: raw light ground (paper, off-white). Source and how it was obtained.

tokens.name: ground-alt
tokens.usage: FILL: raw secondary light surface (cards, tiles, fibre edges).

tokens.name: ground-dark
tokens.usage: FILL: raw dark ground for the dark variant.

tokens.name: ink-raw
tokens.usage: FILL: raw text colour on the light ground.

tokens.name: muted-raw
tokens.usage: FILL: raw secondary text (deck, captions). Must reach 4.5:1 on ground.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: FILL: the brand's identity colour (action, keyword, foil). State where it may and may not be used.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: FILL: pressed or small-text version of brand.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: FILL: slab / secondary colour, or delete if the brand has only one accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: FILL or delete: status success (apps only).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: FILL or delete: status error (apps only).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Post or screen background per variant.

tokens.name: headline
tokens.usage: Headline text on surface. Record the contrast ratio here.

tokens.name: deck
tokens.usage: Deck / body text on surface. Record the ratio.

tokens.name: keyword
tokens.usage: The emphasized word or the action colour. Record the ratio and the minimum size it is allowed at.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Contrasting panel or featured ground.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Rules, hairlines, focus rings.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: FILL: family, weight, casing, tracking of the main headline.

styles.name: headline-alt
styles.usage: FILL or delete: second headline mode (e.g. sentence case, tight).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: FILL or delete: a leading list number.

styles.name: deck
styles.sample: FILL: the sentence that completes the headline.
styles.usage: FILL: deck under the headline on the post canvas.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: FILL or delete: reading text in an app or site.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: FILL or delete: labels, links, chips (apps and sites).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: FILL or delete: captions and meta.

tokens.name: canvas-w
tokens.usage: Post width (all formats).

tokens.name: canvas-h-story
tokens.usage: Stories / Reels cover height (9:16).

tokens.name: canvas-h-feed
tokens.usage: Feed post / carousel height (4:5).

tokens.name: margin-x
tokens.usage: FILL: side text margin on the post canvas.

tokens.name: text-top
tokens.usage: FILL: top of the headline from the canvas top.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom band kept free of key content on 9:16 (Instagram UI).

tokens.name: space-unit
tokens.usage: FILL: base unit of the spacing rhythm.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: FILL or delete: screen gutter in an app or site.

tokens.name: radius-base
tokens.usage: FILL: the default corner (0 = square brand, 16 = soft brand).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: FILL or delete: pills and discs.
